hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path') or '')" | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.cs) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && dotnet format whitespace BunkerFlow.slnx --include "$f" --no-restore --verbosity quiet ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path') or '')" | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.tf) terraform fmt "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
